clue.text: Old boy returning to gambling game in woman's waistcoat!

indicators.note: returning means the abbreviation for old boy goes back the way it came, read backwards

parts.note: OB is the standard abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
dice is a game of chance played for money

explanation.surface: A former schoolboy heads back to the gaming tables wearing a lady's waistcoat.
explanation.definitionFit: A bodice is the close-fitting upper part of a woman's dress, likened here to a waistcoat.

clue.text: Person over time built up wine store

indicators.note: in a down answer, over places the person above the next piece

parts.note: bod is British slang for a person

indicators.note: built up in a down answer means the word for time is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Someone has built a wine store over the years.
explanation.definitionFit: A bodega is a Spanish wine shop or cellar.

clue.text: I, a boy going the wrong way, hit a religious leader

indicators.note: going the wrong way sends the first three pieces backwards up the column

parts.note: a lad is a boy
to lam is to beat or thrash

explanation.surface: A wayward youth strikes a religious figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going the wrong way' turns I A LAD into DALAI.
explanation.definitionFit: The title belongs to the spiritual head of Tibetan Buddhism.

clue.text: Prisoner admitting defeat? One may be in the soup

definitions.text: One may be in the soup

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the prisoner's letters take the defeat inside them

parts.note: con, short for convict, is a prisoner
a rout is a crushing defeat

explanation.surface: A convict confessing failure lands in trouble, in the soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the soup' is also an idiom for being in trouble, which the surface uses.
explanation.definitionFit: A crouton is a small piece of fried bread served floating on soup.

clue.text: Notice the fellow getting torn apart as a partisan

parts.note: an ad, or advertisement, is a public notice
he is the pronoun for a male, the fellow
rent is the past tense of rend, to tear apart

explanation.surface: A poster is ripped down by a man who supports the opposing side.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name a committed supporter or follower of a party or cause.

clue.text: Mister, a dude, contrived to get something much wanted

indicators.note: contrived means artificially put together, so the letters of mister, a and dude are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man and a stylish fellow scheme to get their heart's desire.
explanation.definitionFit: Desideratum is Latin for a thing desired or needed.

clue.text: Old region's old city in a rite, dancing

indicators.note: in places the old city inside the rearranged letters
dancing letters move about, so a and rite are rearranged

parts.note: Ur is the ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: An ancient city where people danced in a ritual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dancing' makes ETRIA, the anagram of A RITE. The 's after region stands for 'is', joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Etruria was the ancient area of central Italy home to the Etruscans.

clue.text: Artist and group of sailors occupying estate briefly

indicators.note: occupying means the sailors sit inside the shortened estate

parts.note: EST is a short form of estate
RN, the Royal Navy, is a body of sailors

explanation.surface: A painter and a crew of seamen take over a country property.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Ernst was a German-born Surrealist painter.

clue.text: Suppose duck has got into the tower

indicators.note: has got into puts the duck inside the following words

parts.note: taken as written
to tower is to rise high above
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so O

explanation.surface: Imagine a duck has got into the tower.
explanation.definitionFit: To theorise is to form a hypothesis, to suppose something is so.

clue.text: A bit of work on toy

indicators.note: in an across answer one piece sitting on another follows it, so the work comes after the toy

parts.note: a doll is a child's toy
op is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: Someone has a small job to do on a plaything.
explanation.definitionFit: A dollop is a small lump or helping of something soft, a bit of it.

clue.text: Remove misbehaving sergeant

indicators.note: something misbehaving is out of order, so the letters of the word sergeant are rearranged

explanation.surface: An order to take away an unruly army NCO.
explanation.definitionFit: To estrange is to alienate or distance someone, to remove them from closeness.

clue.text: Girl's first — paid attention and shone

indicators.note: first here picks out just the opening letter of the word girl's

parts.note: to have listened is to have paid attention to what was said

explanation.surface: A girl takes her turn first, attends carefully, and shines.
explanation.definitionFit: Glistened means sparkled or gleamed, a way of having shone.

clue.text: Reaching no conclusion, like two getting upset and separating

indicators.note: upset in a down answer turns the word upside down, read upwards

parts.note: two is an even number, so like two gives even
rending is tearing apart, separating

explanation.surface: A pair keep falling out and splitting up, never settling things.
explanation.definitionFit: Never-ending means endless, going on without ever reaching a conclusion.

clue.text: Mechanical component to corrode, getting yellow

parts.note: to rot is to decay or corrode
or is the heraldic word for gold or yellow

explanation.surface: A machine part rusting and turning yellow with age.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotor is the rotating part of a motor or engine, a mechanical component.

clue.text: Drunk arrives insane for special celebrations

indicators.note: someone drunk is all over the place, so the letters of arrives and insane are jumbled together

explanation.surface: A tipsy guest turns up wild for the party.
explanation.definitionFit: Anniversaries are yearly dates marked with special celebrations, such as weddings or birthdays.

clue.text: Meddlesome at home — endless responsibility yours truly has

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the word for responsibility is cut off

parts.note: trust is a responsibility placed on someone
yours truly means I, the writer, so yours truly has becomes I've

explanation.surface: A busybody at home, with the speaker carrying constant duties.
explanation.definitionFit: Intrusive describes someone pushing in where unwelcome, which is meddlesome.

clue.text: Old father in Paris staying off booze before a musical show

parts.note: pere is French for father
TT, teetotal, means abstaining from alcohol

explanation.surface: An elderly French dad on the wagon goes to see a musical.
explanation.definitionFit: An operetta is a short, light opera with spoken dialogue.

clue.text: Drama not easily understood? Pretend to lack interest

parts.note: a play is a piece of drama
a point that is hard to get is difficult to grasp

explanation.surface: An obscure stage piece leaves the audience feigning indifference.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a coy show of indifference to make a pursuer keener.

clue.text: He roars awkwardly, having a rougher voice

indicators.note: awkwardly suggests the letters of he roars are put together clumsily in a new order

explanation.surface: A man bellowing clumsily ends up with a harsher voice.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoarse means gruff or rasping in voice; the comparative form means more so.

clue.text: Material from European country ending in Chile

indicators.note: in here means the country's final letter is put in place by the letter from Chile, a swap

parts.note: Germany is a European country

indicators.note: ending picks out only the last letter of the word Chile

explanation.surface: Fabric imported from a European nation and finished in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: Material, in the legal sense, means relevant or pertinent, as does germane.

clue.text: Looked for nothing, after initial change of direction

indicators.note: the first letter, a compass point, changes from north to south

parts.note: nought means nothing, zero

explanation.surface: A fruitless search, after switching course at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Sought is the past tense of seek, to search or look for.

clue.text: Odd sailor rolling over in dance

parts.note: rum is an old-fashioned British word for odd or strange

indicators.note: rolling over turns the sailor's two letters back to front

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a common abbreviation for a sailor

explanation.surface: A peculiar seaman tumbles about while dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: The rumba is a ballroom dance of Cuban origin.

clue.text: Goodness me — solver finally has got it!

indicators.note: finally picks only the last letter of solver

explanation.surface: An exclamation of delight as the puzzler at last cracks it.
explanation.definitionFit: Merit is worth or virtue, the quality of goodness.

clue.text: The most important thing on our menu possibly

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters of on our menu may be arranged in some other way

explanation.surface: A restaurant boasting that its signature dish is on the menu.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian phrase for number one is used to mean the top person or thing.

clue.text: How to provide tips for cooking device

parts.note: read as an instruction, turning the word spit around gives the word tips

explanation.surface: Advice on how to leave gratuities.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnspit is a rotating rod or mechanism for roasting meat over a fire.

clue.text: Bothering about a piece of jewellery

parts.note: ca, from circa, means about or approximately
a ring is a piece of jewellery worn on the finger

explanation.surface: Someone fussing over a trinket.
explanation.definitionFit: To be bothering about something is to mind or be concerned, which is caring.

clue.text: Funny Leo, great friend to be trusted

indicators.note: funny suggests something odd, so the letters of Leo and great are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A comic named Leo is a wonderful, reliable pal.
explanation.definitionFit: An alter ego can mean an intimate and trusted friend, a second self.

clue.text: Fairly good journey down mountain but without sun

indicators.note: without tells us the letter for sun is removed from the longer word

parts.note: a descent is a journey down a slope or mountain
S is the abbreviation for sun, as in Sunday

explanation.surface: A reasonable trip down from the peak, though not in sunshine.
explanation.definitionFit: Decent is used informally for satisfactory or reasonably good.
